secondaryKeywords: real estate AI search, AI search for property marketing
productDescription: Snoika makes real estate brands visible inside AI search, so an agency or portal gets recommended when a prospect asks ChatGPT, Gemini or Perplexity about properties or local real estate services. The work covers getting property listings surfaced through AI answers, positioning a regional agency in AI results for its own area, and turning AI-led property searches into qualified leads. Delivery runs on a retainer combining published content, third-party mentions and community presence, with programmatic pages where the vertical supports them. Source: snoika.com/solutions/real-estate. No price is published for this vertical, so do not state one.

writingPreferences: Address the reader as "you" and assume they run marketing for an agency, a brokerage or a property portal. Never call Snoika a "platform" or a "solution" — it is an agency. Use the vocabulary of the trade: listing, brokerage, portal, agent, viewing. Do not state a property price, a commission rate, a market size or a transaction volume, because none has been supplied. Do not name a competing portal or listing site. Reproduce every figure exactly as supplied and never round it.
